##### Project general facts

Park Five is a contemporary residential development comprising five residential buildings, with the initial phase introducing Towers A and B. The project offers a selection of studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments designed around a concept that combines modern architectural forms with subtle traditional Arabian design influences. Geometric façades, biophilic design principles, spacious balconies, water features, and thoughtfully integrated communal elements create a cohesive residential environment focused on comfort, functionality, and community living. The residences are designed to maximize natural light while maintaining a clean and contemporary aesthetic.

Residents have access to a comprehensive range of amenities designed for recreation, wellness, and social interaction. These include swimming pools, children's play areas, landscaped green spaces, BBQ areas, a community lawn, outdoor and indoor coworking spaces, a rooftop Zen garden, a basketball court, a padel tennis court, communal dining areas, rooftop tea terraces, seating lounges, plunge pools, pet-friendly green areas, and a fully equipped fitness center. The amenity offering supports both active and relaxed lifestyles while encouraging community engagement.

The living spaces and bathrooms feature high-end finishes and premium materials throughout. Interiors are enhanced by abundant natural light and carefully selected fixtures and fittings. All apartments are equipped with a smart home system. Kitchens include built-in appliances. Residences are delivered without furniture. The overall specification reflects a modern finishing standard with high-quality materials and integrated smart-home technology.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Production City (DPC) is a vibrant community designed to foster creativity and innovation, primarily catering to the media, production, and publishing industries. Strategically located near key highways, it offers excellent connectivity to Dubai’s major hubs, including the Dubai Marina and Al Maktoum International Airport. The area is characterized by its modern infrastructure, tailored to meet the needs of businesses, while also offering a dynamic environment for professionals and residents alike.

Beyond its business focus, Dubai Production City provides a balanced lifestyle with a range of amenities. Residential complexes within the district feature contemporary designs and cater to a diverse community. With parks, retail outlets, cafes, and fitness centers, the area promotes a lifestyle of convenience and leisure. Educational institutions and healthcare facilities within close reach further enhance its appeal as a well-rounded community.

DPC also emphasizes sustainability and green living, integrating eco-friendly practices into its design. Lush landscapes and open spaces are thoughtfully incorporated, providing a refreshing environment for residents and visitors. Whether you’re a business professional seeking a dynamic workspace or a family looking for a vibrant neighborhood, Dubai Production City offers a unique blend of innovation, comfort, and connectivity.
